summary:
Independent DESIGN Review of the complete frozen Task56 specification 992b927ce833a8fa9876c7e278d024eca7903763621ea84391c2ad4c09f6916c, current native context 000a894359c24eb9ba19609939aa4b58d0a0877cf6ae088bba4d4128985ab2e1, classification input 365b5f52294b6fb528012f3bcff322294933d788d5eb6b35b7df35e5d6f279f6, DU-001 and all 24 cumulative scope paths. The exported subject is f7d598fca29b5fae710e9b8b641ed044f4923107, base ef92b795da729566870ff4878f100a4ffe319db5, REVIEW/V2, Policy 2.3.0 digest d21a386779147dfad962a0fc0656bef61bc581e27f63c4789dcc06520fa10ff1. Reviewed the full specification and task decision unit, amendment007, report016, preserved byte-exact B589 archive007, failure and prerequisite boundaries, current fixture behavior, and the proper design002/addendum. All 24 scoped files exist; current fixture and test bytes remain the pre-implementation 792f8095 and df3b3b4d versions. No blocking design finding. This same real independent worker has not authored Task56 production, tests or fixtures; design review and verification by this worker are not represented as two different people or an external reviewer product.

The cumulative design retains optional run-owned external pytest roots, ordinary ancestor/container/leaf refusal, unchanged default plan and finalization context, original selectors, environment algorithm and budgets, and the bounded test-side physical-I/O/owned-Git cleanup repairs. It retains content-keyed YAML decoding limited to 64 entries and 16384 characters with independent returned graphs, fresh file reads and all current validation; the narrow Windows birthtime metadata repair and POSIX ctime remain. Session-private original-target builder success, complete live source/config/template/attributes/environment/Git-pair eligibility, shared canonical owner across imports, independent physical Git files, cold behavior and subsequent real governance remain. Rule8 requires the new fixture/tests/documentation safety work to be a separate task-free unit and commit from governed Task56 records. The allowed cumulative scope stays at 24 paths; no production Git transport, Schema, Policy, registry cache or further parser optimization is added.

The new safe implementation is confined to _copy_snapshot and necessary private helpers/imports/constants, with appended test cases; every other existing fixture function body and consumer/test/assertion AST, all 65 current fixture cases, original caller mkdir order, ten-second real Git deadline and owned cleanup remain. Only the current session owner's qualified pristine snapshot warm copy may select parallel batches. First original builder, optional snapshot publication, no-owner and other-source copies remain serial. Preserve all original live guards and actual standard copy2/DirEntry physical independence. Added pre-copy qualification proves ordinary contained source/target, empty target, current finite tree of at most 256 files and known standard bindings. Unsupported/unknown/recoverable qualification exceptions select original serial before copying; BaseException is not disguised as ineligibility. This explicitly adds read and error-observation points, rather than claiming strict serial equivalence. After selection, actual copy or detected unsafe-drift failures drain, retain partials and propagate without serial recopy, cleanup or builder retry.

One local pool has at most four workers and at most 256 total submitted/retained futures, separate bounds. Preserve unsorted scandir DFS order and actual DirEntry inputs. Drain each consecutive regular-file batch in logical submission order before the next recursive directory, coordinator error or postorder directory copystat. Share pool/count through recursion; all descendant writes end before setting directory metadata, including readonly children. Retain the original non-None winerror suppression rule for directory copystat. OS error triples and shutil.Error.args[0] expansion retain logical DFS/postorder shape and order; the earliest logical non-OSError/BaseException retains its actual object and arguments, including priority over later submit/classification/traversal failures. Earlier OS aggregates do not mask a later abort, and aggregation failure itself is an abort at that logical point. Every submitted job reaches terminal state on success and all exception paths; cleanup/shutdown errors must not mask captured original failure. No owned copy threads survive normal return or raise.

The specification explicitly admits already submitted later jobs in the same batch completing writes after an abort; partial contents and arrival timing therefore need not match serial copying. No later directory is entered after the logical abort, and actual partials remain. Binding identity cannot prove absence of registered audit hooks. Real audit events, arguments and logical error attribution remain, while worker callback threads and cross-file event order may change; actual hook failures cannot be bypassed. These bounded fixture semantics are an explicit design choice, not a sandbox claim or general callback equivalence. Existing warm pre-copy current/source/snapshot/mode checks remain; validation performs post-copy pristine proof, but no new per-warm full-tree post-scan is imposed.

Acceptance must append tests for readonly nested metadata, full modes/mtime and independent Git/index/objects/refs/worktree entities; actual DirEntry/copy2 behavior; owner/current drift, unsupported helpers and over-cap serial selection before writes; mixed OS/shutil aggregation and Windows metadata suppression; competing worker/coordinator abort priority; real blocking-job BaseException/error drain, absence of live copy threads, retained partials and no retry. Measure the fixed implementation's complete warm path including added qualification and all existing live guards, with a real first successful builder, real warm hits, fresh physical targets and post-proof. Then execute the complete fixture and original external-review modules under actual locked 3.13.15/full-core computed MINENV, with no extra qualification skips, followed by the full original integration selector within its unchanged 600-second deadline. Only actual prerequisite PASS permits fresh action005 and the complete default native V2 with new source/runtime/import/spec/Policy bindings.

All fourteen native checks, five fixed mutations, original deadlines/selectors/assertions, 85 percent total and 90 percent diff coverage, whitespace/Ruff/format/mypy, independent implementation Review, native finalization, current code approval and Gate remain mandatory. CI remains Python3.11 with required checks and branch protection. Prior failures, consumed actions and receipts remain; action005 is not approved or reusable through this Review. Report016's ten success-domain isolated-copy pairs motivate preparation only; the prototype's early metadata, DirEntry and error differences are not the admitted implementation, and the measured interval excludes complete warm eligibility. The 639.96-second private diagnostic and prior module exits do not satisfy original integration600. This APPROVE is only the current frozen design judgment; it asserts no implementation, runtime choice, performance guarantee, native PASS, publication, Task55 admission, matching-report acceptance or provider/later-phase success.
